preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices N in each test case must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertices u and v in the edges must be within the range of 1 to N.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of edges to add for each test case.
